blocks.text: Thermohaline gardish, jise aksar global conveyor belt kehte hain, zameen ke samandaron ka nazuk amal hai jo hararat garam (tropical) ilaqon se qutbon tak le jata hai. Yeh pani ke darja hararat aur namkeenpan ('thermo' hararat, 'haline' namak) ke farq se chalti hai, jo mil kar samandar ke pani ki density tay karte hain. Khat-e-istiwa ke qareeb garam, kam ghana pani satah ke saath qutbi ilaqon ki taraf hararat le kar jata hai. Qutbi ilaqon mein pani kam darja hararat aur samandari barf banne se barhe namkeenpan ki wajah se thanda aur ghana ho kar doobta aur gehre samandar mein khat-e-istiwa ki taraf wapas behta hai. Yeh musalsal harkat zameen ka mausam qaboo karne, fazai naqshon par asar dalne, aur duniya bhar mein hararat aur ghizai ajza dobara taqseem kar ke samandari ecosystems ko sahara dene mein madad deti hai.

Fig 21.15 mein garam satah ki dhaarein (surkh) qutbon ki taraf behti hain, jahan thandak aur barf banne se un ki density barhti aur woh doob jati hain (neeli). Yeh thanda, ghana pani samandar ki tah ke saath phail kar aakhir doosre ilaqon mein phir oopar aata hai. Is global conveyor belt ki mukammal teen-jehti gardish ko duniya ke tamam samandari tas'lon se pani guzarne mein taqreeban 1000 saal lagte hain, aur yeh hararat aur ghizai ajza dobara taqseem kar ke zameen ka mausam qaboo karne mein nazuk kirdar ada karti hai.

blocks.alt: Samandar ki numaindagi karte dabbe mein saada chakkar. Oopar surkh teer garam, kam ghana satah ka pani tropics (daen) se qutbi ilaqe (baen) ki taraf le jata. Baen neela teer neeche murta jahan pani thanda hota, samandari barf banti, namkeenpan barhta aur ghana pani doobta. Neeche neela teer thanda gehra pani khat-e-istiwa ki taraf wapas le jata, aur daen dashed surkh teer use phir oopar aata (upwelling) dikhata.
blocks.caption: Thermohaline gardish (Fig 21.15 ke mutabiq asal saada khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Satah ka pani hararat qutbon ki taraf le jata hai; jab kafi thanda aur namkeen ho jaye to doob kar gehrai mein wapas aata hai. Yeh chakkar bohat dheema hai lekin bohat zyada hararat muntaqil karta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Thermohaline gardish, 'global conveyor belt', ko duniya ke gird aik poora chakkar lagane mein taqreeban 1000 saal lagte hain. Agar global warming ise sust kar de to Europe ko chhote barfani daur ka samna ho sakta hai, jab ke baqi duniya garam ho rahi ho.

blocks.prompt: Thanda, namkeen pani kyun doob kar gehri dhaara banata hai, aur yeh thermohaline gardish se kaise jura hai?
blocks.explanation: Thanda, namkeen pani gird ke pani se ghana hai, is liye kashish-e-saql use dubo deti hai; doobte hue yeh gehra pani samandar ki tah ke saath khat-e-istiwa ki taraf dhakelta hai. Qutbon par yeh doobna woh 'pump' hai jo thermohaline conveyor belt ki gehri, wapas aane wali shaakh chalata hai.

items: Thermohaline gardish: darja hararat aur namkeenpan (density) se.
Garam satah ka pani qutbon ki taraf; thanda, namkeen pani doob kar gehrai mein wapas; fi chakkar taqreeban 1000 saal.
Hararat tropics se qutbi ilaqon tak.
